title: Sirri gaaboyso dacrisa mari
intro: caxaaxuwi baaxol, cankâ marih butta dite reebih gubat sirri ekraaro bicsen. oson yangalen hadaf luk sugen, takkay immay ken niya gitat tan. Dagom oson yaaxigeenih woo qibaadah maynaqul ken qammaala oson xiinaanam.
clues: Nanu ninni ekraaro rike sinnim akkaluk, maqarle fidga abne.
Nanu udurruteh nawqem niyatne, gersi mari walah esgegeyyeemik naharal.
Nanu ninni xayyosl kibal luk, salfale ekraarol daffesne.
nanu ninni wadba elle gufne innal, nanu tet gorrisnam kee qidim, tonnal nanu ninni gita baynem nakkale.
Tokkeek nanu nummaak ni arac kinnim cedneeh, qaago yirgiqeh weeqneeh, ni qaku ninnik ittah esserimak.
Nanu woo saaku baacoytit ninni gaaboysok ayyaaqenno axcuk xiibineh sugne, takkay immay Yallih digaal nee gufeh nanu xiinak sugne waqdi, ni caxaaxuwih buxaaxih digaal nek yemeete.

identity.label: Nanu iyyaay?
options: Suuratak 68hattoh addat yan Cooci Dagar-Leenah yan mari.

trial.label: Ni gibbatu
options: Ni caxaaxuwih arac qaraanak temeete qawwalaylat finqitteh sugte.
Ni caxaaxuwi arac weeqi duugak suge.

Ni caxaaxuwi arac ardi angoyyat yanxuqe
trial.answer: Ni caxaaxuwih arac qaraanak temeete qawwalaylat finqitteh sugte.

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Nanu xiibineh tet caxâ baxa saaku arqusnuh
Nanu kalaluh gablah addat dabboh gorrisne
location.answer: Nanu xiibineh tet caxâ baxa subci qanxisnuh

outcome.label: Ni Saami
options: Nanu inki gabuuk finqineh qigdu toobitneh
Nanu damaqti fan neh gacisak digaalenno

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
